# Build cmocka from the submodule source
add_library(cmocka STATIC
    ../external/cmocka/src/cmocka.c
)
target_include_directories(cmocka PUBLIC
    ../external/cmocka/include
)
target_include_directories(cmocka PRIVATE
    # This is needed for the config.h generated by configure_file
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
)

# Generate the config.h for cmocka
configure_file(
    ../external/cmocka/config.h.cmake
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h
)

# Define the test executable
add_executable(unit_tests test_version.c)

# Link the core library and cmocka
target_link_libraries(unit_tests PRIVATE edge_core_lib cmocka)

# Register with CTest
add_test(NAME VersionCheck COMMAND unit_tests)
